BFI causes flashing and reduces brightness. Touch-through effects require accessibility access on Android 13 or later. Older Android versions use an overlay that can block touches. CRT requires screen-capture consent and processes captured pixels in memory. Use the Stop notification or Quick Settings tile to remove the overlay. Timing and controller compatibility need separate validation. Acknowledging this notice or granting access never starts output.

Download the complete Slang shader library directly from libretro/slang-shaders on GitHub? The current library is about 53 MiB to download and 70 MiB installed; allow at least 150 MiB free. All presets, shader files, includes, textures and original notices are kept. Categories follow the upstream folders. Some presets require features this renderer does not support. Downloads use your internet connection; screen captures are never uploaded.
Download once, then use the library offline. Categories follow Libretro’s source folders. Not every Slang preset is supported.
Import a self-contained .slang file, or a ZIP containing .slangp presets and their shader files, includes and textures. Compatible Slang features only; unsupported packages show an error.
CRT processes screen capture in memory. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. Protected content may appear black. Locking ends CRT capture; BFI can resume alone after unlocking.
Displays a touch-through BFI and CRT overlay. Does not inspect screen elements or control your input. CRT also requires screen-capture consent. Stop effects from BFI or its notification.
Enable BFI accessibility to use touch-through effects.
Start CRT again to grant screen-capture consent.
BFI resumed. CRT needs fresh screen-capture consent.
Selected shader unavailable. Choose or import a shader.
Optional alternating visible, black counts. Example: 1, 1, 2, 1. Leave empty to use the two counts on the right. Applies globally; app overrides keep their own two-count pattern.
Enter 2–32 comma-separated counts, in visible/black pairs. Each count: 1–120.
Touch passes through on supported devices. Stop effects from the notification.
